meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找回之前的对话和项目背景
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要查阅过去的会话记录来继续工作。
copy.tagline_en: Search past memories to retrieve prior conversations and project context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to look back at previous chat records to continue your work.

howto.what: 装上后,当用户提到过去的会话时,Claude 会去 Claude-Mem 记忆库中搜索相关记录。它先返回带 ID 的摘要表,再查看相关时间线,最后只对筛选出的 ID 获取完整详情。
howto.when: 当用户询问过去会话内容,例如“还记得 X 吗”“上次怎么做的”“mem search”等时触发。

say.text: 还记得我们上次怎么处理登录超时的吗?
say.note: 会先找到相关记录,再给你完整经过。

say.text: 用 mem search 搜一下项目里关于“数据库迁移”的笔记。
say.note: 会按关键词匹配并返回摘要索引。

say.text: 查一下上周会议记录里做出的决定。
say.note: 会按日期范围检索并批量取详情。

howto.what_en: Claude queries the Claude-Mem cross-session memory database. It does: search index -> view timeline -> fetch full details for filtered IDs. Returns past records (title, narrative, facts, concepts, files).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about previous sessions, e.g. “What do you remember about X?”, “How did we do X last time?”, or “mem search”.

say_en.text: Do you remember how we handled login timeout last time?
say_en.note: It finds relevant records and returns the full context.

say_en.text: Use mem search to find notes about database migration in this project.
say_en.note: Matches by keyword and returns the summary index.

say_en.text: Check the decisions made in last week's meeting notes.
say_en.note: Searches by date range and fetches details in batch.
